name: sessions_list
label: Sessions List
description: List active sessions with optional filters by kind, recency, and message preview.

kinds.description: Filter by session kinds: main, group, cron, hook, node, other

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return (minimum: 1)

activeMinutes.description: Only include sessions active within this many minutes (minimum: 1)

messageLimit.description: Number of recent messages to include per session (minimum: 0)
